entries.notes: 片 four, 戶 four, 甫 seven. The dictionary opens 戶 with a long bar (the 戸 form) where all three licensed corpora draw a short dot (the 戶 form). Held for the same reason as 扆

戶 four then 衣 six. The dictionary opens 戶 with a long bar (the 戸 form) where MM draws a short dot (the 戶 form) — 57 units wide against 13. That is a different stroke, not a different direction, so the glyph is held until a source with the dictionary form exists
